description: List the release policies that evaluate every publish of an organization, and the checkers it can configure: Valet's own, and the organization's, which set_checker adds. An organization checker shows its URL, its headers as written, the release files it was approved to receive, and why it is unavailable or what its last call got wrong. Each policy shows its checker, its enforcement (monitor, or block at a severity), its settings, and how its evaluations came out over the last 30 days. A secret setting shows as (set), never its value. Call it before publishing to see what will be evaluated, and fix what you can first. A blocking policy refuses a release with a finding at or above its severity; a monitor policy reports and never refuses. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization whose release policies to list. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.
